label: The bundle of internal grammar, grammar-fixed reference and the wf p1 reconstruction…, by Reductio
meaning: Suppose internal grammar, grammar-fixed reference and the no-being reconstruction. The council defines a confession of the one true God; what it defines is the practice's own standard, so the confession is correct by internality; a correct confession makes 'God' refer to some being; the reconstruction says it refers to none. Contradiction.
